messages:
tess: quick a11y review of the dashboard filters + results table — keyboard users lose place when toggling chips and the table row focus isn't obvious.
maria: can you repro? which flow shows the issue?
tess: open a dashboard, tab to filter chips, toggle a chip, then tab into the results table. Focus lands on the table but the selected row has no visible focus ring and screen reader doesn't announce its row index.
chris: interesting. we use `aria-selected` on rows but don't expose `aria-posinset`/`aria-setsize`, and our focus style was accidentally overwritten in the theme.
a11y-bot: checklist: visible focus on chips & rows, roving tabindex for chip list, table row position info, contrast for chip active state, skiplink to jump to results.
maria: i think we should: 1) implement roving tabindex for chips (arrow keys move focus, Enter toggles), 2) ensure toggled chip has `aria-pressed` and a clear high-contrast outline, 3) restore focus-visible on .table-row with 3px outline using `--focus-ink`.
tess: also add `aria-posinset` and `aria-setsize` to table rows (or use grid+aria-rowindex) so SR users know "row 2 of 8" when navigating.
chris: agree. plus add `aria-describedby` on the table to reference a summary node that updates when filters change, instead of focusing a hidden live region. That avoids moving focus to non-interactive text.
a11y-bot: color note: active chip bg+label meets contrast in dark mode but fails in light-high-saturation theme. Recommend token `--interactive-500` for bg and `#06121a` for text to hit >=4.5:1.
maria: let's also add a small "Skip to results" hidden skiplink that becomes visible on keyboard focus so power users can jump straight into the table.
tess: implementation plan: 1) add roving tabindex + arrow key handlers for chips; 2) set `aria-pressed` on toggle; 3) restore focus-visible CSS for chips and `.table-row`; 4) add aria-posinset/aria-setsize on rows; 5) create an `aria-describedby` summary node that updates on filter change and lives in `role=status` for polite announcements; 6) add skiplink.
chris: i'll raise a PR with unit tests for roving tabindex and a small integration keyboard test that asserts focus movement + SR announcements (axe baseline).
a11y-bot: follow-up: run manual VoiceOver+TalkBack checks for the chip->table flow after merge and attach notes.
maria: thanks tess — nice catch. small changes that make filter+results much more usable for keyboard & SR users. :thumbsup:
